# implicit-sdf.library: CircularUnionDistance

**Status:** Supported (tier `geometry`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> The union of two distances joined by a quarter-circle fillet of the given
> radius — a true arc, unlike the polynomial SmoothUnionDistance.
> Precondition: radius is positive. (hg\_sdf: fOpUnionRound.)

## Signature

```plato
CircularUnionDistance(a: Number, b: Number, radius: Number): Number
```

### Law_CircularUnionIsCommutative

[stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato, line 220](../../../../../stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato#L220)

```plato
// The exact circular fillet, like every union variant, is symmetric.
Law_CircularUnionIsCommutative(a: Number, b: Number, radius: Number): Boolean
    => radius <= 0.0
    || CircularUnionDistance(a, b, radius).LawEq(CircularUnionDistance(b, a, radius));
```

### Law_CircularUnionAwayFromSeamIsUnion

[stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato, line 226](../../../../../stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato#L226)

```plato
// Far from the seam — where both operands exceed the fillet radius — the exact
// circular union has nothing to round and must agree with the sharp minimum.
Law_CircularUnionAwayFromSeamIsUnion(a: Number, b: Number, radius: Number): Boolean
    => radius <= 0.0 || a < radius || b < radius
    || CircularUnionDistance(a, b, radius).LawEq(UnionDistance(a, b));
```

### Line 708

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/implicit-sdf.library.plato, line 708](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/implicit-sdf.library.plato#L708).

```plato

    // The union of two distances joined by a quarter-circle fillet of the given
    // radius — a true arc, unlike the polynomial SmoothUnionDistance.
    // Precondition: radius is positive. (hg_sdf: fOpUnionRound.)
    CircularUnionDistance(a: Number, b: Number, radius: Number): Number {
        var corner = Vector2D((radius - a).Max(0.0), (radius - b).Max(0.0));
        return radius.Max(a.Min(b)) - corner.Magnitude;
    }
```
